source_version: Rolling Container Apps managed identity pull guide
retrieval_method: public Microsoft Learn via web.run; curated extract
extract:
Your Azure Container Registry must allow ARM audience tokens for authentication in order to use managed identity to pull images.
az acr config authentication-as-arm show -r <REGISTRY>
az acr config authentication-as-arm update -r <REGISTRY> --status enabled
Assign pull permissions to the actual configured registry pull identity.
limitations: Documentation evidence only. No Azure authorization or live operation tested.
